newsitem.title: USA: US auto sales up 4.2 pct end-Aug 96 vs end-Aug 95.
newsitem.headline: US auto sales up 4.2 pct end-Aug 96 vs end-Aug 95.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales rose 4.2 percent in the last 10 days of August 1996 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research auto sales report.
Domestic car sales rose to 241,368 in the 10-day survey period, up from 233,524 in the same period a year ago, CNW said. Import car sales rose to 82,354 from 80,003, CNW said.
Domestic truck sales climbed to 172,543 in end-August 1996 from 163,593 end-August 1995, the report said. Import truck sales rose to 18,351 from 18,124, it said.
CNW said 33.5 percent of the vehicles were leased, up from 32.9 percent in the same survey period last year.
About 10.44 million vehicles were sold in 1996 from January through August, CNW said.
"It's a pretty sure bet the auto industry will hit the 15.2 million unit mark for the year," the report said.
